text:
I visited for a dental cleaning and came away with a very positive experience.

What I appreciated:
- English speaking
- Gentle but through cleaning
- Hygienist explained each step of the process to make sure I was aware and comfortable

Things to note:
- If this is your first dental cleaning in TH and you are from the US (not sure about other countries), a face mask will be placed over your face which protects you from the spray of the ultrasonic tooth scaler, however it is also effectively a blindfold (common in TH but not typical in the US). If this is your first time, having your eyes covered can be a little anxiety inducing, however the hygienists explanation at each step helps quite a bit.
